title: New major hospital, Brisbane: piling
workplace: New major hospital with a hospital tower, two level basement and rooftop helipad, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: CFA piles for the hospital podium
swms.task: Drill and install CFA piles for the hospital podium with the CFA piling rig, placing the reinforcement cages with the crane company's mobile crane.

facts.rigExclusionZone: Each rig has a fenced and signed exclusion zone of 25 m radius. Only the rig crew enters, with the operator's agreement, controlled by the piling supervisor.
facts.pilingPlatform: The working platform is designed by the geotechnical engineer for the CFA rig, with a maximum plant loading of 250 kPa. The platform certificate is given to the rig operator before the rig goes on it.

steps: Work with the crane crew during lifts
Lift and plunge cages into the fresh CFA pile

swms.title: Bored piles for the hospital tower core
swms.task: Drill bored piles up to 20 m deep for the hospital tower core, lift and lower the reinforcement cages into the open bores with the crane company's mobile crane, and place concrete by tremie.

facts.rigExclusionZone: Each rig has a fenced and signed exclusion zone of 25 m radius. Only the rig crew enters, with the operator's agreement, controlled by the piling supervisor.
facts.pilingPlatform: The working platform is designed by the geotechnical engineer for the CFA rig, with a maximum plant loading of 250 kPa. The platform certificate is given to the rig operator before the rig goes on it.

steps: Work with the crane crew during lifts
Lift, pitch and lower reinforcement cages
